sections.title: Letter bi sound
paragraphs: The letter is (bi) /bi/. It makes the sound in (bene) /ˈbɛ.ne/, which means well, good. This letter has only one sound.

sections.title: Saying letter bi
paragraphs: Press both lips firmly together to stop the air. Release them cleanly while you turn your voice on. Place your hand on your throat to feel the buzz.

sections.title: Reading letter bi
paragraphs: This letter always makes the sound in (bello) /ˈbɛl.lo/. You also hear it inside words like (albero) /ˈal.be.ro/.

sections.title: Letter bi mistakes
paragraphs: Do not release a puff of air like in bad. Keep the burst very light and crisp.
